Nguyen Quynh Nhu

Restaurant Manager

Store Manager with over 5 years of experience in the Hospitality industry. Experienced in managing a team of 20 subordinates. Highly organized and disciplined, constantly innovating to improve products and services. Always prioritizes customer experience and strives to expand brand awareness to a wider user base.

MW Hotel & Residence TopCV

Restaurant Manager

  1. Monitor and manage the quantity and quality of tools, equipment, and cooking ingredients in the hotel restaurant.
  2. Work directly with the kitchen to resolve issues related to the quantity and quality of daily meals.
  3. Responsible for food hygiene and safety in the restaurant.
  4. Handle customer complaints about food quality, restaurant conditions, and service attitude.
  5. Manage staff including task assignment and scheduling based on actual operations.
  6. Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and training new employees.
  7. Manage monthly budget, costs, and revenue.
  8. Propose ideas to improve food and service quality to enhance customer experience.
  9. Collaborate with Marketing team to implement periodic promotions.

02/2020

-

12/2021

SVT Coffee & Tea TopCV

Store Manager

  1. Responsible for store revenue and reporting business results to Area Supervisor.
  2. Create weekly work schedules for all store staff.
  3. Manage the quantity and quality of raw materials.
  4. Manage store equipment and machinery conditions.
  5. Recruit and train new staff.
  6. Ensure food hygiene and safety in the store.
  7. Propose and implement promotional activities and incentive programs to attract customers and increase store revenue.
Skills

Human Resource Management

I have extensive experience in building and leading teams. With a team size of up to 20 people, I always strive to create a professional, transparent, and efficient working environment. I focus on hiring the right people, clear task allocation, and continuous training so that each employee can maximize their strengths and work toward common goals.

Problem Solving & Handling Situations

In daily operations, I frequently handle customer complaints and unexpected situations. I always remain calm and listen carefully to provide appropriate solutions that ensure customer satisfaction while protecting the restaurant's reputation and stability.

Operations & Quality Control

I am detail-oriented in operations, from weekly planning, monitoring ingredients' quantity and quality, to supervising cooking and service processes. I pay special attention to food hygiene and safety and continuously improve food and customer service quality daily.
